title: Active Learning of Temporal Specifications through Distinguishing Queries
abstract: arXiv:2611.17866v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Temporal specifications are essential for verification and monitoring, yet writing formulas that capture the intended behaviour is difficult. Active learning derives such specifications through interaction between a learner and a teacher, but remains underexplored for temporal logics. Existing approaches require the teacher to answer equivalence queries and to construct counterexamples, and they often rely on SAT-based learning procedures that restart the search after each new example. We present an active-learning framework for LTLf in which the teacher only labels traces and answers natural-language questions about the intended behaviour. The learner maintains an enumerated version space of candidate formulas, generates traces that distinguish candidates, and uses the teacher's hints to rank candidates or to restrict the search. translated_title: 通过区分性查询主动学习时序规约
translated_abstract: 时序规约对于验证和监控至关重要，然而编写能够刻画预期行为的公式却十分困难。主动学习通过学习者与教师之间的交互来推导此类规约，但在时序逻辑领域仍未得到充分探索。现有方法要求教师回答等价查询并构造反例，且往往依赖基于SAT的学习过程，每遇到新示例就需要重启搜索。我们提出了一种针对LTLf（有限时域线性时序逻辑）的主动学习框架，其中教师仅需对轨迹进行标注，并用自然语言回答关于预期行为的问题。学习者维护一个枚举的候选公式版本空间，生成能够区分不同候选公式的轨迹，并利用教师提供的提示来对候选公式排序或限制搜索范围。我们证明了该框架与观测示例的一致性，以及在有界假设类内的可识别性（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出了一种LTLf时序规约的主动学习框架，教师只需标注轨迹并用自然语言回答问题，学习者通过维护枚举版本空间并生成区分性查询来高效学习目标规约，避免了传统方法中等价查询、反例构造和搜索重启的开销。
en_tdlr: Proposes an active learning framework for LTLf temporal specifications where the teacher only labels traces and answers natural-language questions, while the learner maintains an enumerated version space and generates distinguishing queries to efficiently identify the target specification without equivalence queries, counterexamples, or search restarts.
